I was stopped at the intersection in League City, waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic so I could make a left turn. My
foot was on the brake and my car was fully stopped when a vehicle coming through the intersection struck the side of
my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt my body jolt against the seatbelt and door. I got out and

did not seek care that day. That evening, on 14 Nov 2023, I noticed a sharp ache in my right shoulder that got worse

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
